title: Removing a Low Rating from the Average — Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts Exclusion Terms
content:
**Terms.** For Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts, a rating of 1, 2 or 3 stars is removed from the rating average when its cause is one of the exclusion reasons of the shopper's level and the order's records show that cause:

| Exclusion reason | What the order's records must show |
|---|---|
| Out-of-stock items | A substitution decision on the order recorded as item not found and refunded |
| Customer unreachable | The order was returned |
| Store delay | A review case records it |
| App outage | A review case records it |

An exclusion must be requested within the request window counted from the rating date. The window is counted in calendar days with the rating's date as day 0, and the last day to request is that date plus the level's request days, inclusive. A shopper receives at most the level's number of exclusions in any rolling 30 calendar days, counted by the exclusion dates of the exclusions already granted. Each rating can be excluded once, and 4 or 5 star ratings are never excluded.

## Figures by level

| Level | Request days after the rating date | Exclusions in a rolling 30 days |
|---|---|---|
| Shop-Only Shopper | 7 | 3 |
| Full-Service Shopper | 7 | 3 |
| Full-Service Shopper Silver | 7 | 4 |
| Full-Service Shopper Gold | 10 | 5 |
| Full-Service Shopper Platinum | 10 | 6 |
| Full-Service Shopper Diamond | 14 | 8 |

## The request window at its edges (hypothetical dates)

A Full-Service Shopper Gold receives a 2-star rating dated 5 August. The rating date is day 0; the last day to request is 5 August plus 10 days, 15 August.

| Request date | Inside the window |
|---|---|
| 15 August | Yes — the last day is included |
| 16 August | No |

The window is read from the rating's own date on the account record.

## Truth table for one rating

| Stars 1 to 3 | Reason in the list and shown by the order's records | Inside the window | Under the rolling 30-day count | Not already excluded | Excluded |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| No (4 or 5 stars) | — | — | — | — | No |
| Yes | Yes | No | — | — | No |
| Yes | Yes | Yes | No | — | No |
| Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No |
